name: CI - Affected

# ARCH-CI-005: Replaced global npm run scripts with nx affected commands
# SEC-CI-002: All third-party actions pinned to full commit SHAs
# ARCH-CI-006: Removed github.sha from NX cache key
# ARCH-CI-007: Split lint/type-check/test into parallel jobs so build always runs
# ARCH-CI-008: Increased timeouts (cold cache), reduced parallel (memory), save Nx cache after build
# ARCH-CI-009: Push-to-main runs affected lint/type-check/test/build as code-health.

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  # The merge queue (main ruleset) builds each group's merge commit and asks
  # for the same required checks; a workflow that does not listen here
  # leaves every queued entry waiting until the queue's timeout.
  merge_group:
    types: [checks_requested]

# SEC-CI-021: Minimum token permissions — prevents compromised actions from
# pushing commits, creating releases, or modifying repository settings.
permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  NODE_VERSION: '22'
  NPM_CONFIG_CACHE: .npm-cache
  SENS_API_GATEWAY_CI_FEATURES: health,telemetry,metrics,strict-security,scada-display,lorawan,signed-deploy,tpm,st-bytecode,multi-task-scheduler,opc-ua-server,live-debug,license-enforce

jobs:
  detect-changes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      base_sha: ${{ steps.range.outputs.base_sha }}
      dependency_audit_required: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.dependency_audit_required }}
      docs_changed: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.docs_changed }}
      farm_checks_required: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.farm_checks_required }}
      full_validation: ${{ steps.range.outputs.full_validation }}
      has_changes: ${{ steps.check.outputs.has_changes }}
      deploy_changes: ${{ steps.check.outputs.deploy_changes }}
      head_sha: ${{ steps.range.outputs.head_sha }}
      infra_image_changed: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.has_infra }}
      infra_matrix: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.infra_matrix }}
      is_pr: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'merge_group' }}
      range_reason: ${{ steps.range.outputs.range_reason }}
      rust_checks_required: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.rust_checks_required }}
      selection_reason: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.selection_reason }}
      sensor_checks_required: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.sensor_checks_required }}
      validation_started_epoch: ${{ steps.range.outputs.validation_started_epoch }}
    steps:
      # SEC-CI-002: pinned to SHA
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Resolve immutable affected range
        id: range
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "validation_started_epoch=$(date +%s)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = "push" ]; then
            if git ls-remote --exit-code --refs origin refs/tags/deployed/development >/dev/null; then
              git fetch --force --no-tags origin \
                '+refs/tags/deployed/development:refs/tags/deployed/development'
            else
              lookup_status=$?
              if [ "$lookup_status" -ne 2 ]; then
                echo "::error::Unable to resolve the development deployment baseline from origin."
                exit "$lookup_status"
              fi
              if git rev-parse --verify refs/tags/deployed/development >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                git tag --delete deployed/development
              fi
            fi
          fi
          node scripts/ci/resolve-affected-range.ts \
            --event-name "${{ github.event_name }}" \
            --ref "${{ github.ref }}" \
            --pr-base-sha "${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha }}" \
            --head-sha "${{ github.sha }}" \
            --development-ref deployed/development

      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: npm

      - name: Install workspace graph dependencies
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --prefer-offline

      - name: Resolve Nx and catalog scope
        id: scope
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ steps.range.outputs.base_sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ steps.range.outputs.head_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/ci/select-deployment-scope.ts \
            --repo "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" \
            --base-sha "$BASE_SHA" \
            --head-sha "$HEAD_SHA" \
            --requested-services auto \
            --channel development
      - id: check
        env:
          DEPLOY_CHANGES: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.has_images }}
          VALIDATION_REQUIRED: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.validation_required }}
        run: |
          echo "has_changes=$VALIDATION_REQUIRED" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "deploy_changes=$DEPLOY_CHANGES" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Shared setup: install + cache (reusable via needs + cache restore)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  install:
    needs: detect-changes
    if: needs.detect-changes.outputs.has_changes == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      redis:
        image: public.ecr.aws/docker/library/redis:7-alpine
        ports:
          - 6379:6379
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      nats:
        image: public.ecr.aws/docker/library/nats:2.10-alpine
        ports:
          - 4222:4222
          - 8222:8222
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "nats-server --version"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 10s
          --health-retries 10
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Cache Nx
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .nx/cache
          key: nx-ci-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            nx-ci-${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit

      # Persist node_modules for downstream jobs
      - name: Cache node_modules
        uses: actions/cache/save@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: node_modules
          key: nm-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lint, type-check, test: PR + push-to-main code-health gate
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  lint:
    needs: [install, detect-changes]
    if: >-
      needs.detect-changes.outputs.has_changes == 'true' &&
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'merge_group' ||
       (github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      redis:
        image: public.ecr.aws/docker/library/redis:7-alpine
        ports:
          - 6379:6379
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      nats:
        image: public.ecr.aws/docker/library/nats:2.10-alpine
        ports:
          - 4222:4222
          - 8222:8222
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "nats-server --version"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 10s
          --health-retries 10
    timeout-minutes: 40
    # continue-on-error removed: lint failures must block PR merge.
    # BEFORE: lint errors showed green in GitHub — no signal to reviewers or authors.

# ARCH-CI-006: Removed github.sha from NX cache key
# ARCH-CI-007: Split lint/type-check/test into parallel jobs so build always runs
# ARCH-CI-008: Increased timeouts (cold cache), reduced parallel (memory), save Nx cache after build
# ARCH-CI-009: Push-to-main runs affected lint/type-check/test/build as code-health.

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  # The merge queue (main ruleset) builds each group's merge commit and asks
  # for the same required checks; a workflow that does not listen here
  # leaves every queued entry waiting until the queue's timeout.
  merge_group:
    types: [checks_requested]

# SEC-CI-021: Minimum token permissions — prevents compromised actions from
# pushing commits, creating releases, or modifying repository settings.
permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  NODE_VERSION: '22'
  NPM_CONFIG_CACHE: .npm-cache
  SENS_API_GATEWAY_CI_FEATURES: health,telemetry,metrics,strict-security,scada-display,lorawan,signed-deploy,tpm,st-bytecode,multi-task-scheduler,opc-ua-server,live-debug,license-enforce

jobs:
  detect-changes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      base_sha: ${{ steps.range.outputs.base_sha }}
      dependency_audit_required: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.dependency_audit_required }}
      docs_changed: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.docs_changed }}
      farm_checks_required: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.farm_checks_required }}
      full_validation: ${{ steps.range.outputs.full_validation }}
      has_changes: ${{ steps.check.outputs.has_changes }}
      deploy_changes: ${{ steps.check.outputs.deploy_changes }}
      head_sha: ${{ steps.range.outputs.head_sha }}
      infra_image_changed: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.has_infra }}
      infra_matrix: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.infra_matrix }}
      is_pr: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'merge_group' }}
      range_reason: ${{ steps.range.outputs.range_reason }}
      rust_checks_required: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.rust_checks_required }}
      selection_reason: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.selection_reason }}
      sensor_checks_required: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.sensor_checks_required }}
      validation_started_epoch: ${{ steps.range.outputs.validation_started_epoch }}
    steps:
      # SEC-CI-002: pinned to SHA
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Resolve immutable affected range
        id: range
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "validation_started_epoch=$(date +%s)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = "push" ]; then
            if git ls-remote --exit-code --refs origin refs/tags/deployed/development >/dev/null; then
              git fetch --force --no-tags origin \
                '+refs/tags/deployed/development:refs/tags/deployed/development'
            else
              lookup_status=$?
              if [ "$lookup_status" -ne 2 ]; then
                echo "::error::Unable to resolve the development deployment baseline from origin."
                exit "$lookup_status"
              fi
              if git rev-parse --verify refs/tags/deployed/development >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                git tag --delete deployed/development
              fi
            fi
          fi
          node scripts/ci/resolve-affected-range.ts \
            --event-name "${{ github.event_name }}" \
            --ref "${{ github.ref }}" \
            --pr-base-sha "${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha }}" \
            --head-sha "${{ github.sha }}" \
            --development-ref deployed/development

      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: npm

      - name: Install workspace graph dependencies
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --prefer-offline

      - name: Resolve Nx and catalog scope
        id: scope
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ steps.range.outputs.base_sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ steps.range.outputs.head_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/ci/select-deployment-scope.ts \
            --repo "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" \
            --base-sha "$BASE_SHA" \
            --head-sha "$HEAD_SHA" \
            --requested-services auto \
            --channel development
      - id: check
        env:
          DEPLOY_CHANGES: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.has_images }}
          VALIDATION_REQUIRED: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.validation_required }}
        run: |
          echo "has_changes=$VALIDATION_REQUIRED" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "deploy_changes=$DEPLOY_CHANGES" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Shared setup: install + cache (reusable via needs + cache restore)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  install:
    needs: detect-changes
    if: needs.detect-changes.outputs.has_changes == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      redis:
        image: public.ecr.aws/docker/library/redis:7-alpine
        ports:
          - 6379:6379
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      nats:
        image: public.ecr.aws/docker/library/nats:2.10-alpine
        ports:
          - 4222:4222
          - 8222:8222
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "nats-server --version"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 10s
          --health-retries 10
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Cache Nx
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .nx/cache
          key: nx-ci-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            nx-ci-${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit

      # Persist node_modules for downstream jobs
      - name: Cache node_modules
        uses: actions/cache/save@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: node_modules
          key: nm-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lint, type-check, test: PR + push-to-main code-health gate
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  lint:
    needs: [install, detect-changes]
    if: >-
      needs.detect-changes.outputs.has_changes == 'true' &&
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'merge_group' ||
       (github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      redis:
        image: public.ecr.aws/docker/library/redis:7-alpine
        ports:
          - 6379:6379
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      nats:
        image: public.ecr.aws/docker/library/nats:2.10-alpine
        ports:
          - 4222:4222
          - 8222:8222
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "nats-server --version"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 10s
          --health-retries 10
    timeout-minutes: 40
    # continue-on-error removed: lint failures must block PR merge.
    # BEFORE: lint errors showed green in GitHub — no signal to reviewers or authors.

      - development-deploy-mode
      - deploy-development

      always() &&
      github.event_name == 'push' &&
      github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      needs.detect-changes.outputs.deploy_changes == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

      - name: Require successful development delivery
        run: |

          results=(

            "development-deploy-contract:${{ needs.development-deploy-contract.result }}"
            "development-deploy-mode:${{ needs.development-deploy-mode.result }}"

          # the images are built and pinned, only the droplet rollout waits.
          # Every other mode must have deployed.

            fi

    needs:
      - detect-changes
      - build-development-images
      - deploy-development
    if: >-
      always() &&
      github.event_name == 'push' &&
      github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      needs.deploy-development.result == 'success'

          IMAGE_STARTED_EPOCH: ${{ needs.build-development-images.outputs.image_started_epoch }}
          IMAGE_FINISHED_EPOCH: ${{ needs.build-development-images.outputs.image_finished_epoch }}
          DEPLOY_STARTED_EPOCH: ${{ needs.deploy-development.outputs.deploy_started_epoch }}
          DEPLOY_FINISHED_EPOCH: ${{ needs.deploy-development.outputs.deploy_finished_epoch }}

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      base_sha: ${{ steps.range.outputs.base_sha }}
      dependency_audit_required: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.dependency_audit_required }}
      docs_changed: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.docs_changed }}
      farm_checks_required: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.farm_checks_required }}

      has_changes: ${{ steps.check.outputs.has_changes }}
      deploy_changes: ${{ steps.check.outputs.deploy_changes }}
      head_sha: ${{ steps.range.outputs.head_sha }}
      infra_image_changed: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.has_infra }}
      infra_matrix: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.infra_matrix }}
      is_pr: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'merge_group' }}
      range_reason: ${{ steps.range.outputs.range_reason }}
      rust_checks_required: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.rust_checks_required }}
      selection_reason: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.selection_reason }}
      sensor_checks_required: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.sensor_checks_required }}
      validation_started_epoch: ${{ steps.range.outputs.validation_started_epoch }}
    steps:
      # SEC-CI-002: pinned to SHA
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Resolve immutable affected range
        id: range
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "validation_started_epoch=$(date +%s)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = "push" ]; then
            if git ls-remote --exit-code --refs origin refs/tags/deployed/development >/dev/null; then
              git fetch --force --no-tags origin \
                '+refs/tags/deployed/development:refs/tags/deployed/development'
            else
              lookup_status=$?
              if [ "$lookup_status" -ne 2 ]; then
                echo "::error::Unable to resolve the development deployment baseline from origin."
                exit "$lookup_status"
              fi
              if git rev-parse --verify refs/tags/deployed/development >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                git tag --delete deployed/development
              fi
            fi
          fi
          node scripts/ci/resolve-affected-range.ts \
            --event-name "${{ github.event_name }}" \
            --ref "${{ github.ref }}" \
            --pr-base-sha "${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha }}" \
            --head-sha "${{ github.sha }}" \
            --development-ref deployed/development

      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: npm

      - name: Install workspace graph dependencies
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --prefer-offline

      - name: Resolve Nx and catalog scope
        id: scope
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ steps.range.outputs.base_sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ steps.range.outputs.head_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/ci/select-deployment-scope.ts \
            --repo "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" \
            --base-sha "$BASE_SHA" \
            --head-sha "$HEAD_SHA" \
            --requested-services auto \
            --channel development
      - id: check
        env:
          DEPLOY_CHANGES: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.has_images }}
          VALIDATION_REQUIRED: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.validation_required }}
        run: |
          echo "has_changes=$VALIDATION_REQUIRED" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "deploy_changes=$DEPLOY_CHANGES" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  # Shared setup: install + cache (reusable via needs + cache restore)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    needs: detect-changes

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

          - 6379:6379
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      nats:
        image: public.ecr.aws/docker/library/nats:2.10-alpine
        ports:
          - 4222:4222
          - 8222:8222
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "nats-server --version"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 10s
          --health-retries 10
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Cache Nx
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .nx/cache
          key: nx-ci-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            nx-ci-${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit

      # Persist node_modules for downstream jobs
      - name: Cache node_modules
        uses: actions/cache/save@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: node_modules
          key: nm-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lint, type-check, test: PR + push-to-main code-health gate
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  lint:
    needs: [install, detect-changes]
    if: >-
      needs.detect-changes.outputs.has_changes == 'true' &&
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'merge_group' ||
       (github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      redis:
        image: public.ecr.aws/docker/library/redis:7-alpine
        ports:
          - 6379:6379
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      nats:
        image: public.ecr.aws/docker/library/nats:2.10-alpine
        ports:
          - 4222:4222
          - 8222:8222
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "nats-server --version"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 10s
          --health-retries 10
    timeout-minutes: 40
    # continue-on-error removed: lint failures must block PR merge.

name: CI - Affected

# ARCH-CI-005: Replaced global npm run scripts with nx affected commands
# SEC-CI-002: All third-party actions pinned to full commit SHAs
# ARCH-CI-006: Removed github.sha from NX cache key
# ARCH-CI-007: Split lint/type-check/test into parallel jobs so build always runs
# ARCH-CI-008: Increased timeouts (cold cache), reduced parallel (memory), save Nx cache after build
# ARCH-CI-009: Push-to-main runs affected lint/type-check/test/build as code-health.

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  # The merge queue (main ruleset) builds each group's merge commit and asks
  # for the same required checks; a workflow that does not listen here
  # leaves every queued entry waiting until the queue's timeout.
  merge_group:
    types: [checks_requested]

# SEC-CI-021: Minimum token permissions — prevents compromised actions from
# pushing commits, creating releases, or modifying repository settings.
permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  NODE_VERSION: '22'
  NPM_CONFIG_CACHE: .npm-cache
  SENS_API_GATEWAY_CI_FEATURES: health,telemetry,metrics,strict-security,scada-display,lorawan,signed-deploy,tpm,st-bytecode,multi-task-scheduler,opc-ua-server,live-debug,license-enforce

jobs:
  detect-changes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      base_sha: ${{ steps.range.outputs.base_sha }}
      dependency_audit_required: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.dependency_audit_required }}
      docs_changed: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.docs_changed }}
      farm_checks_required: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.farm_checks_required }}
      full_validation: ${{ steps.range.outputs.full_validation }}
      has_changes: ${{ steps.check.outputs.has_changes }}
      deploy_changes: ${{ steps.check.outputs.deploy_changes }}
      head_sha: ${{ steps.range.outputs.head_sha }}
      infra_image_changed: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.has_infra }}
      infra_matrix: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.infra_matrix }}
      is_pr: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'merge_group' }}
      range_reason: ${{ steps.range.outputs.range_reason }}
      rust_checks_required: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.rust_checks_required }}
      selection_reason: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.selection_reason }}
      sensor_checks_required: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.sensor_checks_required }}
      validation_started_epoch: ${{ steps.range.outputs.validation_started_epoch }}
    steps:
      # SEC-CI-002: pinned to SHA
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Resolve immutable affected range
        id: range
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "validation_started_epoch=$(date +%s)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = "push" ]; then
            if git ls-remote --exit-code --refs origin refs/tags/deployed/development >/dev/null; then
              git fetch --force --no-tags origin \
                '+refs/tags/deployed/development:refs/tags/deployed/development'
            else
              lookup_status=$?
              if [ "$lookup_status" -ne 2 ]; then
                echo "::error::Unable to resolve the development deployment baseline from origin."
                exit "$lookup_status"
              fi
              if git rev-parse --verify refs/tags/deployed/development >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                git tag --delete deployed/development
              fi
            fi
          fi
          node scripts/ci/resolve-affected-range.ts \
            --event-name "${{ github.event_name }}" \
            --ref "${{ github.ref }}" \
            --pr-base-sha "${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha }}" \
            --head-sha "${{ github.sha }}" \
            --development-ref deployed/development

      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: npm

      - name: Install workspace graph dependencies
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --prefer-offline

      - name: Resolve Nx and catalog scope
        id: scope
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ steps.range.outputs.base_sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ steps.range.outputs.head_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/ci/select-deployment-scope.ts \
            --repo "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" \
            --base-sha "$BASE_SHA" \
            --head-sha "$HEAD_SHA" \
            --requested-services auto \
            --channel development
      - id: check
        env:
          DEPLOY_CHANGES: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.has_images }}
          VALIDATION_REQUIRED: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.validation_required }}
        run: |
          echo "has_changes=$VALIDATION_REQUIRED" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "deploy_changes=$DEPLOY_CHANGES" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Shared setup: install + cache (reusable via needs + cache restore)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  install:
    needs: detect-changes
    if: needs.detect-changes.outputs.has_changes == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      redis:
        image: public.ecr.aws/docker/library/redis:7-alpine
        ports:
          - 6379:6379
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      nats:
        image: public.ecr.aws/docker/library/nats:2.10-alpine
        ports:
          - 4222:4222
          - 8222:8222
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "nats-server --version"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 10s
          --health-retries 10
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Cache Nx
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .nx/cache
          key: nx-ci-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            nx-ci-${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit

      # Persist node_modules for downstream jobs
      - name: Cache node_modules
        uses: actions/cache/save@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: node_modules
          key: nm-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lint, type-check, test: PR + push-to-main code-health gate
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  lint:
    needs: [install, detect-changes]
    if: >-
      needs.detect-changes.outputs.has_changes == 'true' &&
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'merge_group' ||
       (github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      redis:
        image: public.ecr.aws/docker/library/redis:7-alpine
        ports:
          - 6379:6379
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      nats:
        image: public.ecr.aws/docker/library/nats:2.10-alpine
        ports:
          - 4222:4222
          - 8222:8222
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "nats-server --version"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 10s
          --health-retries 10
    timeout-minutes: 40
    # continue-on-error removed: lint failures must block PR merge.
    # BEFORE: lint errors showed green in GitHub — no signal to reviewers or authors.

The learned conventions that touch any of ``paths`` — latest row per
pattern_id, confidence ≥ ``min_confidence``, strongest first, capped.

This is the read that puts the conventions ledger into production:
``record_convention`` has written a row on every converged cycle since
V9.0-F, and until the mint-time envelope enrichment (Plan "ARIA Sinir
Sistemi" FAZ 4) nothing ever read one back. Same verified-chain
discipline as ``lookup_pattern``: a quarantined ledger yields nothing
rather than something unverifiable.

`base_dir` is keyword-REQUIRED (no default) on purpose: a summary that
cannot open the store cannot honestly claim anything about artifact
integrity, and a default would let a caller silently produce that claim.
